# Jerome Bettis Leadership Award | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.

com

Student athletes have a unique opportunity to offer mentoring support to their peers to help them learn and grow on AND off the field!

The Pittsburgh Steelers and The Mentoring Partnership are teaming up with The Pittsburgh Post-Gazette and Giant Eagle to present the Jerome Bettis Leadership Award, featuring high school football players from around the region who go above and beyond to provide mentor-like support for their teammates.

Each player receives:

  1.

An on-field celebration at a Steelers home game
  2.

A $1,000 donation to their school's football program
  3.

Recognition on Steelers social media channels



NOMINATE NOW 

"I give back because of what I was given.
As a young athlete, I benefited from mentorship both on and off the field.
Throughout my career, I strived to be a positive influence on my teammates and in my community.
I firmly believe sportsâand athletes in particularâhave the power to make a lasting impact on their schools and communities.

" - Jerome Bettis

2025 WINNERS

#### 

Connor Hiser

**South Fayette High School**

**_Senior | OL_**

Connor is a true leader for his football team and community.
He is an active leader in school as a member of the National Honor Society, as well as an active member of his community.
Connor volunteered at the Veterans Rock Concert, the Miracle League of Pittsburgh, and volunteers to mentor all of South Fayettes youth football and elementary school activities.
Connor is always willing to take on a leadership role to help mentor others no matter the situation.

#### 

Charles Simmons

**Bethel Park High School**

**_Senior | FB/LB_**

Charles is an exemplary leader in his community and on his football team.
He prides himself on integrity, inclusivity, and giving back to others by showing younger players the ropes and leading by example both on and off the field.

Charles is also active in his community, extending his influence off the field as an active member of the Best Buddies Club where he works with and develops connections with students who have special needs and disabilities.
He is also heavily involved as a volunteer within his church.

#### 

Max Topper

**Greensburg Salem High School**

**_Senior | WR/LB_**

Max is an excellent leader for Greensburg Salem's football team, as well as in his community.

He spends his spare time mentoring youth football players, and volunteering for roadside clean-up projects, events supporting victims of domestic violence, and working with local businesses to connect sports programs in the community.
Max is a captain of the football team, but his contributions as a leader don't stop there, as he is also the President of National Honor Society, and a member on the Leadership Council.

#### 

Marques Council Jr.

**Aliquippa High School**

**_Senior | QB_**

Marques is a model student-athlete for his team and community.
He leads both on and off the field with poise, confidence, and a team first mentality that inspires everyone around him.
He sets the standard for academic discipline for not only himself, but those around him.
He also invests his time in mentoring younger students and athletes in the community, using his own journey and experience to show how hard work and resilience will open doors for the future.

#### 

Colin Whyte

**West Greene High School**

**_Senior | OL/LB_**

Colin is an excellent role model for West Greene Football and in his community.
As a captain of the football team, Colin leads by example and serves as the go to person for teammates and peers to confide with.
He is also at the top of his class and the potential valedictorian, a member of National Honor Society, and heavily involved in his community.
Colin works with the youth programs, participates in food drives and blood drives.

#### 

Tommy Wuycheck

**Seneca Valley High School**

**_Senior | OL/DL_**

Tommy is the ideal role model for @SVRaiderFB and his community.
He is a member of Seneca Valley's Student-Athlete Leadership Team, a team captain for the football team, and brings a contagious positive energy every day that those around him follow.
He is also heavily involved in community service activities such as St.
Ferdinand's White Elephant Sale and assisting with local youth football leagues and summer camps.
Tommy is a selfless young man who is quick to direct praise to his teammates and coaches.

2024 WINNERS

##  HIGH SCHOOL GIRLS FLAG 

#### 

Zoey Cieslak

**Shaler Area High School**

**_Junior | RB/LB_**

Zoey is a three-year starter and captain for Shaler's girls flag football team and a two-year captain for the girls soccer team.
Zoey is a dedicated leader in the Shaler community, an active member of the GATE program, a student tutor, and consistently volunteers at community middle and elementary schools.
Zoey also ranks amongst the top of her class academically.

#### 

Carmen Pietro

**Seneca Valley High School**

**_Senior | WR_**

Carmen is the team captain for Seneca Valley's flag football team.
In her leadership role, Carmen has consistently demonstrated her ability to foster strong relationships and help her teammates build valuable life skills outside of athletics.
Carmen led the efforts in organizing and designing the Seneca Valley Flag Football homecoming float.
Carmen is also active in her community, volunteering at her church's summer camp, where she cares for preschool students ensuring their safety and enjoyment.
Additionally, Carmen volunteers at the Pittsburgh Holiday Banquet to serve less fortunate families in the Pittsburgh area during the holiday season.

#### 

Ava Chizmar

**South Allegheny High School**

**_Senior | LB/RB_**

Ava is a dedicated leader for the South Allegheny flag football team and serves as captain of the varsity volleyball team, where her compassion and leadership have made a profound impact on the student body.

Ava is deeply involved in her community through volunteering at local churches and animal shelters, and participates in Yearbook, the Hospitality Club, National Honor Society, and the FBI Teen Academy.
Ava plans to attend Montana State University to study chemistry.

#### 

Margaret Mary Sweeney

**Our Lady of the Sacred Heart High School**

**_Senior | WR/DB_**

Margaret is a standout team captain of the (OLSH handles) flag football team and co-captain for the cross-country team.
A dedicated leader on and off the field, she is an active member of National Honors Society, student government, campus ministry and serves as a student ambassador.

Margaret is also active in her community, accumulating 700+ volunteer hours throughout high school, a 12-year Girl Scout, and volunteers with the Mary's Gate Grab & Go lunch program, providing meals to families in need.

#### 

Meredith Huzjak

**Upper St.

Clair High School**

**_Senior | WR/DB_**

Meredith is a three-sport team captain, AP Scholar, National Honor Society Secretary, active member of Kids Helping Kids Club and on track to be valedictorian.
Meredith played a key role in launching the girls flag football team at Upper St.
Clair, leading recruitment efforts and organizing logistics.
Widely praised for her leadership and positivity, she is a driving force behind her team's success on and off the field.
She plans to attend Wake Forest University in the fall to study Biomedical Engineering.

#### 

Javylah Macon

**Sto-Rox High School**

**_Senior | WR_**

Javylah is a dedicated leader and exemplifies leadership and sportsmanship as the captain of the flag football team.
She has built a culture and environment of trust, encouragement and respect amongst the Sto-Rox flag football team by helping every teammate, making sure they feel included.
She is also dedicated member in her school and community.
Her dedication and perseverance inspire younger girls to get involved in sports and do so with a smile on their face.
Javylah is an honor roll student and actively gives back by volunteering at school and community events.

#### 

Shayla Washington

**Brashear High School**

**_Senior | QB/DB_**

Shayla is a proven leader both on and off the field through her strong work ethic and sportsmanship.
She is always the first to celebrate and congratulate her teammates' successes, leading to a positive team environment that others follow.
She is also a dedicated mentor, making positive impacts on her peers in school, at home, and in her community through her positive attitude and commitment to growth.
Shayla proudly serves as captain of the girl's flag football, basketball, and volleyball teams.
Shayla plans to attend Duquesne University in the fall to study Pre-Law.

##  HIGH SCHOOL BOY'S FOOTBALL 

#### 

Jayden Salada

**New Brighton High School**

**_Senior | QB/DB_**

Jayden is an exceptional leader at New Brighton who positively influences his teammates by leading through example both on and off the football field.
Beyond his role at the local YMCA, he stands out as a peer leader and, most notably, ranks in the top 10 of his class.

#### 

Amari Eleam

**Carrick High School**

**_Senior | WR/DB_**

Amari leads by example both on and off the field at Carrick High School, demonstrating his commitment through his leadership in the Raider Walk, where he actively participates in cleaning up local neighborhoods.
Additionally, he volunteers as a youth flag football referee for the Pittsburgh Flag Football League.

#### 

Carson Heinle

**Kiski Area High School**

**_Senior | QB_**

Carson, a leader on the football, basketball, and track teams at Kiski Area, also assists students with disabilities in developing their skills.
He is an advocate for Athletes Supporting Athletes, encouraging his teammates to support other sports teams at the school.
Additionally, Carson is an active member of the Key Club, dedicating his time helping booster and community groups.

#### 

Braiden Sudor

**_Bishop Canevin High School_**

**_SR - Center_**

Braiden, a three-year captain and community pillar at Bishop Canevin High School, plays a pivotal role both on and off the field.
Braiden leads volunteer groups, organizes team study halls, participates in school missions, and competes in academic competitions.
Braiden also showcased his academic excellence by winning a prestigious pharmaceutical competition at the University of Pittsburgh.

#### 

Nick Hage

**_Moon Area High School_**

**_Senior - OT/DE_**

Nick, a dedicated leader and communicator for Moon Area football, organizes his teammates to support other schools' teams during their athletic seasons.
As a partner on the unified Bocce team and a member of Partners in PE, he actively supports students with special needs.
Additionally, Nick led a care drive at Pediatric Specialty Care, collecting essential items for children with medical conditions at the Specialty Care Center.

#### 

Cooper Dann

**_Greensburg Salem High School_**

**_Senior | WR/LB_**

Cooper, a dedicated leader both on and off the field at Greensburg Salem, sets an example for his teammates through his actions.
In addition to serving on the leadership council, he actively participates in Mini Thon, a charity organization supporting pediatric cancer.
Cooper also gives back to the community by officiating youth flag football games.

#### 

Arison Walker

**Aliquippa High School**

**_Senior | WR/DB_**

Arison, a senior leader at Aliquippa High School, exemplifies leadership through his actions, serving as a positive role model for the Little Quips Youth Football team both on and off the field.
As a dedicated member of the Aliquippa community, he actively participates in organizations such as Aliquippa Impact, Drug-Free Aliquippa, and the Honor Society.

#### 

Paul Williamson

**Chartiers-Houston High School**

**_Senior | OT/Nose Gaurd_**

Paul, a Senior captain for Chartiers-Houston football, exemplifies leadership both on and off the field, consistently holding his teammates to high standards of performance and commitment.
An active member of the Chartiers-Houston community, Paul participates in programs like the Team Leadership Council.
He plans to pursue a college degree and continue playing football at the next level.

#### 

William Scoop Smith

**Woodland Hills High School**

**_Junior | WR/DB_**

An All-State and two sport All Conference student athlete, William is active in his community providing free meals during holidays to families in need through his non-profit foundation.
William was honored as the President of his Junior class while also maintaining a GPA of 3.

#### 

Sam Brackney

**Central Catholic High School**

**_Senior | OL_**

Sam is an 1st team All-Conference student athlete who demonstrates what it takes to be a positive role model on and off the football field.
Sam is active at Pittsburgh Central Catholic, engaging in leadership committees, Student Council, My Brother's Keeper, including Mission trips to Jamacia.
Sam currently has a scholarship offer to Brown University and has interest in Cybersecurity.

#### 

Dominic Brown

**Baldwin High School**

**_Senior | TE/LB_**

Dominic is a team captain who holds leadership roles in Student Government, Student Council, as well as Treasurer of the National Honor Society at Baldwin High School.
A high honor student athlete with a 4.
1 GPA, Dominic unselfishly arrives early to practice and leaves late to help teammates obtain new skills on and off the field.
Dominic plans to pursue business upon graduation.

2023 WINNERS

#### 

Dante Saputo

_**South Allegheny High School**_

_**Senior | OL/DL**_

Dante has imposing size for a football player at 6'1" and 340 pounds, but his heart may be the biggest thing about him.
He is the go-to guy for peer issues, and has earned Eagle Scout this year as a true community project.
His teammates helped him build a cross along the Great Allegheny Passage for the community to gather for reflection and peace.
His current plans are to be a City of Pittsburgh Firefighter.

#### 

Amare Harper

_**Sto-Rox High School**_

_**Senior | OL/DL**_

As the captain of the young Vikings football team, Amare has taken it upon himself to help teammates be successful on and off the field, leading study tables to help show them the best way to attack their academics.
Amare serves on several extra-curricular activity boards to help improve the culture and safety of students throughout the entire Sto-Rox School District.

#### 

Carson Pierce

_**Shaler Area High School**_

_**Senior | ILB**_

Carson leads by example on and off the field, never missing a workout and near the top of his class.
He values daily interaction with peers and teachers with a bright personality in the hallways.
When he's not competing on the field, Carson organizes support and attendance for other Shaler activities and events.
He also led the way and made sure to welcome the new freshmen players with advice about the football program.

#### 

Andrew Sharp

_**Baldwin High School**_

_**Senior | RB/LB**_

Andrew is an all-conference athlete who overcame injuries in his last two seasons.
Leading by example, the three-year captain is building bridges throughout the school with his invovelment in numerous peer groups.
The high-honors student can be found in the community helping coach upcoming Highlanders in their flag football program.

#### 

Nate Deanes

**_South Fayette High School_**

**_Senior | RB_**

As a two-year captain for the Lions, Nate is always looked to in challenging situations and viewed as a coach on the field.

On track to be a three-time All-Conference player, Nate is looked at by the senior class as a role model, organizing community service with Light of Life Rescue Mission and providing bagged lunches for 150 homeless children and families.

#### 

Drew Hairston

**_Serra Catholic High School_**

**_Senior | OT/DE_**

Drew is an outstanding student-athlete with a 5.
0 GPA.
Drew's efforts in the classroom have motivated his teammates to put more emphasis on being a better student-athlete.
As a leader of the offensive line, he knows everyone's duties and communicates them well.
Drew has won several class medals for top academic standing to go along with his on-field honors.

#### 

Vasile Balouris

**_Pine Richland High School_**

**_Senior | WR/DB_**

Vasile is a two-year captain with high marks in the classroom, including a near-perfect SAT and perfect ACT score.
He mentors many teammates while playing football and basketball.
Vasile leads the Ram's team volunteers activities, is active in his church and serves as a referee for the youth basketball program.

#### 

Mason Williams

**_Canon-McMillan High School_**

**_Senior | LG/DT_**

Mason is a thoughtful leader with a calm demeanor that drives the team mission of making better men through the game of football.
He is a great listener and seeks out players that may be facing challenges to help them work though obstacles.
He can be found volunteering at almost every community event, including the food bank, cleaning town parks and parade days.

#### 

Braeden Helmkamp

**_Trinity High School_**

**_Senior | OT/DE_**

Though Braeden holds multiple Division-1 football offers, he still continues to put his teammates and community first.
He is a great mentor for all the young Hillers, helping to set up the field for practice, excelling in the classroom, and volunteering at numerous events in the community.
Braeden defines the Hiller's Person-Student-Player philosophy.

#### 

Julian Stevens

**_Greensburg Salem High School_**

**_Senior | TE/LB_**

Julian is a three-sport athlete that exhibits extraordinary leadership and mentoring abilities.
Julian makes sure teammates are well taken care of and provides excellent motivation and communication skills.
He has led several school and community initiatives and leads the way for players to support other school sports and activities, including community youth football.

#### 

Keith Mincin

**_Baldwin High School_**

**_Senior | RB/LB_**

Keith is an All-Conference football player, highly ranked wrestler and high-honors student and serves on the Executive Board of his school's National Honor Society.
He is a rare 4-year captain of the football team and can be found tutoring teammates and other students and just saying hi to everyone when he walks in a room.
Keith can also be found volunteering on the weekends helping coach and referee for youth flag football.
